name: Kira Marie Peter-Hansen - Après le § 30 - Am 13
title: REPORT on European Semester for economic policy coordination 2026
part_text: 30b. Believes that instead of promoting harmful budgetary cuts and structural reforms in order to reach the debt and deficit targets prescribed by the Stability and Growth Pact, the EU economic governance framework should favour and facilitate the collection at both Member State and EU level of additional resources through fair taxation, in particular taxes on the wealthiest and on multinational companies, taxes on ecologically harmful products and services, the removal of ineffective and unfair tax and social contribution exemptions, and the fight against tax dodging and tax evasion on the part of wealthy individuals and multinational companies;
